message: I have always been self-conscious about my smile. My front teeth are uneven and I have some discoloration that whitening strips have not helped with. I am interested in learning about veneers or bonding options. I want a natural-looking improvement, not overly white or perfect. Budget is a concern but I want to understand all my options.

My wife says I should fix my smile before our daughters wedding in September. I have a chipped front tooth from years ago and my teeth have yellowed over time. I am also missing a molar on the lower right that I have been ignoring. Looking for realistic options and timeline to get this done before the wedding.

I had braces as a teenager but my teeth have shifted back over the years. My bottom teeth are crowded again and my bite feels off. I get headaches sometimes and my jaw clicks. I also want my teeth whitened. Is Invisalign an option at my age (34)? I want to fix everything at once if possible.
